---
title: "Hello, PARI/GP"
engine: pari-gp
format: html
---

The engine runs every `{gp}` cell in one `gp` session, so state carries over.

```{gp}
p = nextprime(10^30)
```

`p` is still in scope in the next cell:

```{gp}
factor(p - 1)
```

```{gp}
#| echo: false
print("this cell's code is hidden")
```
